world: ⭐⭐⭐ C THE CLAUSES DO NOT SHARE A UNIT, AND THE RELEASE SHIPS 986 CORE INSTANCES. `data/conversation_rubrics.jsonl` carries a `coval_core` for each of 986 conversations, k distributed {2: 1, 3: 43, 4: 942} — objects this site did NOT build, on disk in the release, untouched by this entire arc. ⛔ SO STATEMENT.md's 'THE RELEASE SHIPS ONE CORE' IS TRUE ONLY AT THE ARM LEVEL: one core GENERATOR, 986 core INSTANCES, and the deliverable never states which it means. That is the instrument-unit-versus-claim-unit distinction this arc has flagged in eleven rounds, sitting in its own headline. ⭐⭐ AND THE FORMULATION ITSELF MIXES UNITS: F1 and F2 are predicates over a GENERATOR — a selection procedure, a score across prompts — while F3 is a predicate over an INSTANCE's cardinality. A three-clause definition whose clauses range over different objects cannot be applied to any single object as written, and no round in this arc has said so. ⭐ THE ONE PORTABLE RESULT: F3 admits 1.0000 of the 986 instances, and the card's published 'up to four, ~95% are four' reproduces at max k = 4 and 0.9554 — the FIRST application of any clause to objects this site did not build, in 1 of 3 clauses. ⚠ The other 2 are NOT EVALUABLE here and are reported as such, never as passing: they need a provenance record and per-arm scores the rubric file does not carry. ⚠ AND F3 ADMITTING ALL 986 IS WEAK EVIDENCE FOR F3 — the clause's ceiling was read off this release's card, so admitting this release's instances is close to circular; what it establishes is that the card's statement is TRUE OF THE DATA. ⚠ UNIT GAP, stated twice because it is both this round's control and its finding: instrument unit is A CORE INSTANCE, claim unit is THE FORMULATION'S APPLICABILITY.

F1 provenance.reading: 'the criteria were SELECTED without reading the outcome labels' is a predicate over a SELECTION PROCEDURE, checkable from the producer

F2 behaviour.reading: 'the criteria BEAT a baseline that never sees the prompt' needs scores ACROSS prompts, so it ranks a procedure, not one criteria list

F3 size.reading: 'more than one criterion, no more than the release's maximum' is a predicate over the CARDINALITY of a single criteria list
